children: PDS Biotechnology entered into a First Amendment to its $6 million Promissory Note with YA II PN to strengthen liquidity and accelerate repayments. The amendment adds weekly remittances of net ATM proceeds, extends the Nasdaq listing deficiency cure period to 180 days, and requires 100% of net cash from any non-ATM equity or equity-linked financings to redeem the note within five business days. The amendment becomes effective upon execution and the company’s payment of the installment due September 14, 2026.
: First Amendment to Promissory Note (original principal $6,000,000)
: Enhance liquidity and accelerate debt repayment
